review_type: independent fixed-revision diff/reference review, native image inspection and focused test reruns
verdict: Run 20 closes the specific guided-cache variants/guards and blank final-column capture defects from round 19. The new telemetry group matches the inspected C# assignments after messages arrive. Exact software parity remains incomplete, with concrete CurrentState defaults, derived values and high-latency handling gaps as well as the known video, plugin, localization and native transport/platform gaps. No 10/10.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-original software parity scores, not completion percentages. Overall equally weights UI/UX and features. Prior reports provide gap context, not fresh verification of every earlier implementation claim.

rationale: The last-column native capture now displays watts through yaw and a bottom scrollbar. Its receipt matches the current executable. The guided observer now handles legacy and integer mission items only for current=2 and mission_type=MISSION, and observes position-target coordinates regardless of ignore bits like the original. Wire tests pass. Generator, EFI, hardware, primary MCU, memory, RPM, AOA/SSA, fence and sixteen ESC channels add real state behavior. However, an empty extra map still yields null/absent numeric properties before telemetry, unlike the original numeric defaults, and derived acceleration magnitude and HIGH_LATENCY/HIGH_LATENCY2 decoding remain missing. The wider explicit software gaps prevent a 10.

reference/MissionPlanner/ExtLibs/ArduPilot/CurrentState.cs generator, EFI, hardware, MCU, memory, RPM, AOA/SSA, fence and ESC assignments

The final image visibly contains the final status labels. MP_STATUS_END sets a developer offset; it does not replay a desktop scrollbar drag.

Parent reports one earlier round-19 tlog wait timeout followed by passing isolated and full reruns. Its root cause remains unproven.
verification_limits: This reviewer ran 11 focused tests, not the full workspace suite.
Original Mission Planner was not launched for equal-state native pixel or interaction comparison.
No desktop scrollbar drag was replayed. Native final labels and egui pointer-event behavior are distinct pieces of evidence.
No native HTTP/script-to-DATA marker update or MAV/connection-switch workflow was driven in this review.

The decoder test verifies selected hardware/generator/EFI values and all 64 ESC outputs through field lookup, numeric lists and JSON. It does not assert every newly added RPM, AOA/SSA or fence output, nor all generator/EFI fields.
No exhaustive fresh review of earlier pages, swarm algorithms, all CurrentState properties or all original message branches was performed.
Non-Windows runs and mobile packages/devices remain unverified. Physical flight, camera and radio qualification is separate from the software score.
scope.reviewer_actions: Read-only inspection and focused tests; authored judging/round-20.json only. No implementation edits, commit, push or subagents.

run20_dispositions.area: Observed guided-cache message forms and guards
run20_dispositions.closed_parts: Both MISSION_ITEM and MISSION_ITEM_INT require current=2 and mission_type=MISSION. SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT has the original mask-independent cache observation. The production-link test rejects fence/rally cache overwrites for both item forms and accepts a legacy mission item and a position target with ignored position bits.
run20_dispositions.remaining: Closure concerns the specific round-19 observer discrepancies. Native selected-MAV marker/altitude/frame interactions still lack a desktop workflow replay.

run20_dispositions.closed_parts: A finite content-width minus available-width offset replaces f32::MAX. The native image shows watts, wind fields, transponder fields, xtrack_error and yaw. Both normal and final captures show the bottom bar. The independent egui rerun actually drags the scrollbar at two small sizes.
run20_dispositions.remaining: No native desktop drag at normal or small window size was replayed. This closes the blank-capture defect and supplies final-label proof, not an original/native interaction comparison.

run20_dispositions.area: Added hardware, engine, fence and ESC telemetry
run20_dispositions.closed_parts: Inspected assignments match the original scales and primary ECU/MCU selection, freemem32 fallback, EFI zero-fuel-pressure sentinel and all sixteen ESC channels. The focused test passes and checks all 64 ESC values through field, fields and property JSON.
run20_dispositions.remaining: This is a coherent decoded-message subset. Original defaults and other numeric/derived properties remain incomplete; not every new assignment has a behavioral assertion.

remaining_software_gaps.area: CurrentState defaults, derived numeric values and missing decoder branches
remaining_software_gaps.next_fix: Match explicit original numeric defaults and chooser membership before telemetry, implement accelsq/accelsq2/accelsq3 from the decoded axes, then port HIGH_LATENCY/HIGH_LATENCY2 state updates. Use original-derived fixtures for defaults and message output, and audit remaining properties/message branches rather than treating registered names as complete behavior.
concrete_discrepancies: Rust starts extra empty and returns null or omits an unresolved numeric field. The existing test explicitly expects default gen_speed to be null; the original float property begins at zero.
The original acceleration magnitudes compute sqrt(ax^2+ay^2+az^2)/1000 for each IMU. Rust registers these names but provides no field computation or update assignment.
The C# reference updates state from HIGH_LATENCY and HIGH_LATENCY2; Rust's CurrentState update match has no corresponding branches.

remaining_software_gaps.next_fix: Implement actual GStreamer discovery/source/stop behavior and HereLink plus payload/gimbal video flows. Verify a deterministic stream through visible DATA controls.
Implement the original plugin lifecycle and callback/page capability through a compatibility host. The current file listing and disabled controls do not load .NET plugins.
Apply translated resources and persisted culture and verify non-English language switching against the original.
Add BLE/WinUSB/custom transport behavior and mobile file/USB serial adapters, then build and exercise native packages. Windows tests alone do not establish these platform flows.

remaining_software_gaps.area: Native interaction and remaining map/tool parity evidence
remaining_software_gaps.next_fix: Drive DATA scrollbar, HTTP/script guided target, altitude edits and MAV/connection switches through the desktop. Track the documented GDAL raster/opacity and place-name geocoder gaps separately and resolve them before claiming exact parity.

ten_out_of_ten_criterion: An honest 10 requires no known material software discrepancy in the promised exact-clone scope and adequate decoder, interaction and native-platform evidence. This run makes verified progress but leaves concrete missing behavior, so a 10 is not supportable.
